features.name: donation_frequency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total donations (V2) to months since first donation (V1), capturing donation rate over time
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures donation intensity; frequent donors relative to tenure may differ in transfusion likelihood

features.name: recency_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree-splittable ordinal encoding of recency for direct threshold splits

features.name: volume_per_donation
features.description: Average blood volume donated per visit (V3 / V2), measuring per-donation volume consistency
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes total volume by frequency; consistent donors cluster around 250cc per donation

features.name: volume_deviation_from_standard
features.description: Absolute deviation of average volume per donation from standard 250cc unit
features.expected_model_benefit: Flags donors whose per-donation volume deviates from standard, indicating data anomalies or irregular donations

features.name: tenure_to_recency_ratio
features.description: Ratio of time since last donation (V1) to time since first donation (V4), measuring recency relative to tenure
features.expected_model_benefit: Low ratio means donor donated recently relative to their history; high ratio means lapsed donor

features.name: is_recent_donor
features.description: Binary flag: 1 if last donation was within 6 months (V1 <= 6), else 0
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct boolean split for tree models on recency threshold

features.name: high_frequency_donor
features.description: Binary flag: 1 if total donations (V2) >= 5, indicating habitual donor behavior
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates habitual from occasional donors for tree splits

features.name: log_total_volume
features.description: Log-transformed total blood volume donated (V3) to compress skewed distribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness in V3 for better tree splits across volume range

features.name: donation_gap_months
features.description: Average months between donations: (V4 - V1) / np.maximum(V2 - 1, 1), estimating inter-donation interval
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures regularity of donation schedule; shorter gaps indicate committed donors

features.name: recency_frequency_interaction
features.description: Product of recency bucket and frequency (V2), capturing joint effect of when and how often donated
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear interaction term for tree models to capture combined recency-frequency signal

features.name: long_tenure_low_frequency
features.description: Semantic score (0-3) assessing donor who has long history but few donations: 0=not applicable, 1=mild, 2=moderate, 3=strong lapsed pattern. Based on V4 > 24 and V2 < 4 and V1 > 12 combinations
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies lapsed donors with long history but infrequent recent activity, a distinct behavioral segment

features.name: active_loyal_donor_score
features.description: Composite loyalty score (0-4) based on semantic assessment of recency (V1 low), frequency (V2 high), volume (V3 high), and tenure (V4 high) together indicating an active loyal donor
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple signals into a loyalty index that tree models can split on directly
